problem: Powerhouse detected failures and drift but could leave PLANNED operations, ESCALATED reconciliation and GREEN_STALE production truth non-terminal while other surfaces still appeared healthy.
root_cause: Detection, ownership, recovery and terminal verification were separate mechanisms without one aggregate fail-closed terminal health invariant.

The autonomous replay-window optimizer re-evaluated an already-promoted 12-hour safe floor by constructing another 12-hour challenger, making challenger_window < champion_window impossible and recreating a false INSUFFICIENT_REPLAY_EVIDENCE blocker.
fix: Add one server-only terminal control-plane health view.
Every five minutes safely requeue only stale internal operations whose side-effect state is explicitly NOT_STARTED.
Reconcile GREEN_STALE through the existing canonical production-truth reconciler.
Treat ESCALATED reconciliation, stale planned work and stale green truth as unhealthy.
Make the 12-hour proven optimization floor an idempotent terminal no-op.
truth_boundary: Candidate is not LIVE_PROVEN until protected merge, versioned production migration application, cron/function/view readback and runtime health readback succeed.
